personality: 3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, highly precise digital concierge that blends Swiss minimalism with warm architectural luxury.

spacing.rule: Generous, architectural whitespace. Elements should feel intentionally placed with breathing room. Cards and sections must never feel cramped.

do's: Use subtle glass (expo-blur) for sticky bottom tab bars and floating action buttons.
Apply frosted glass over high-quality architectural imagery for text readability.
Use glass for sticky section headers when content scrolls underneath.
dont's: Do not overuse glass on standard data cards or form fields.
Do not stack multiple glass layers on top of each other.
Never compromise text legibility; always use a subtle tint behind the blur.

screens.name: Home (Public Marketing)
screens.purpose: Showcase OKA Bau's premium services and brand identity with cinematic 3D imagery and editorial layouts.

states.loading: Subtle skeleton loaders mimicking image blocks.
states.error: Elegant text prompt to reload the page.

screens.layout: Hero section with full-bleed 3D architectural image, vertical gradient scrim, and oversized headline 'Räume. Immobilien. Lösungen.' Large rounded masonry cards (lg: 20px radius) for 'Projekte' and 'Leistungen'. 'Interactive Service House' uses image with absolute-positioned glassmorphism hotspot buttons. Generous 3xl vertical padding between sections.

screens.name: Mein Projekt (Client Portal)
screens.purpose: Provide clients with a high-end, transparent view of their construction progress and administrative documents.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner with 'Projekt wird geladen...'
states.empty: Glass card with 'Noch keine aktiven Projekte' and CTA to request one.
states.error: Clean error message with a subtle reload button.

screens.layout: Header: 'Guten Tag, [Vorname]'. Top card: 3D digital twin / cover photo with gradient scrim. Below: Horizontal scrollable 'Progress Zones' using strict requested status colors (Gray, Orange, Amber, Green, Red). A vertical 'Timeline' with subtle border lines. 'Before/After Slider' section using smooth reanimated gestures. Document and invoice links in clean, minimalist list rows with chevrons.

screens.name: Admin / CRM Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage leads, projects, tasks, and media library in a streamlined, highly functional view.
screens.layout: Utility-focused but retains premium whitespace. Kanban lead pipeline using horizontal scroll (cards with md:12 radius, solid white on warm gray background). Badges for project statuses. Actionable employee tasks list.

hero_3d_architecture.alt: Premium luxury living room with brown leather sofa and large windows, representing modern architecture

agent_portrait.alt: Portrait of Katharina Kling, professional female real estate agent

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces' personality strictly.

Implement the specific status colors requested by the user: Planned (neutral gray #8A8A8A), In Progress (warm orange #D96C40), Waiting (amber #F59E0B), Completed (soft green #4E8563), Problem (red #B94A48). Map these to their respective UI elements (badges, timeline dots).

For the Home (Public Marketing) screen, ensure the Hero section utilizes a full-bleed 3D architectural image overlayed with a vertical gradient scrim to ensure the 'Räume. Immobilien. Lösungen.' headline is highly legible. The typography should be oversized.
For the Client Portal ('Mein Projekt'), implement a sleek UI for the Before/After slider and Progress Zones. Use smooth react-native-reanimated transitions.
Ensure 'lots of whitespace'. Use the spacing scale strictly, prioritizing padding around cards and between sections to convey luxury.
Rely on 'Geist' for text and 'Satoshi' for display. If not available, use comparable precise, modern neo-grotesk fonts.
Keep glass effects subtle. Use them for sticky headers and the bottom tab bar to create depth without visual noise.
